text:
Ravi: Heads-up: customer 'orion' reported SCIM creating duplicates after our RBAC role rename. Provisioner logs show KMS Decrypt errors and SAML NameID parsing differences. Can infra/security triage?

Maya: ACK. Paste logs + sample SAML assertion.

Ravi: Logs (sanitized):
```
2026-05-08T08:12:40Z ERROR provisioner: decrypt extid failed: kms.Decrypt error: AccessDeniedException
2026-05-08T08:12:40Z INFO provisioner: fallback to username -> created svc-orion-ingest-2
```
SAML NameID: Format="persistent">urn:example:acct|svc-orion-ingest

Ethan: Likely two issues: alias/key rotation without provisioner role in policy + NameID delimiter change so our parser fails to extract stable id.

Lena: Immediate mitigations: 1) Pause SCIM for tenant orion; 2) Rollback key alias or re-add provisioner role to key policy; 3) Add shallow-audit row (ciphertext-hmac) before decrypt so deprovision attempts are visible even on decrypt failure.

Maya: I'll roll back alias and verify KMS policy includes arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/provisioner. Command: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <id>` then `put-key-policy` to reapply.

Ethan: After policy fix run a dry-run rewrap with destination-encryption-context {"tenant":"orion","purpose":"extid"} and then run recon job to merge duplicates. Also add provisioner change: on decrypt failure, enqueue into dedupe-review queue instead of blind create.

security-bot: Incident created SEC-2026-081 "SCIM duplicates due to KMS alias rotation + NameID parsing" https://redwood.incidents/SEC-2026-081

Ravi: Assignments: Maya fix key policy + rollback alias, Ethan run rewrap dry-run and recon, Lena open PR for audit shim and dedupe-guard, I'll notify CS and hold unpause until recon completes. Post updates here.

oncall-bot: Pager alerted to sec-oncall.

Maya: Policy rolled back at 2026-05-08T08:25:12Z; provisioner role present. Post-rollback KMS logs show no AccessDenied for provisioner.

Ethan: Dry-run rewrap (sample=100) started 2026-05-08T08:40Z with preserve-context flag; results: 100/100 success. Recon queued.

Lena: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/provisioner/pull/915 - adds audit-shim and dedupe enqueue on decrypt-failure. Tests added to simulate KMS AccessDenied.

Ravi: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with recon merge status and customer unpause decision.
